quests.dispatcherQuestion: Advanced nuclear incident at a foreign facility requiring international coordination. Input code!
quests.explanation: International nuclear coordination engages IAEA emergency response capabilities and bilateral technical assistance agreements.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Radioactive plume trajectory crossing five international borders. Input code!
quests.hint: Issue a five-border radioactive plume alert.
quests.explanation: Cross-border plume alerts provide each nation with location-specific shelter and evacuation guidance based on trajectory modeling.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Nuclear emergency response teams from three nations converging on the site. Input code!
quests.explanation: Joint nuclear response commands integrate teams from multiple nations under standardized IAEA emergency response protocols.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Orbital debris field expanding and threatening multiple national satellite systems. Input code!
quests.hint: Issue an orbital crisis emergency code.
quests.explanation: Orbital crisis codes trigger coordinated satellite maneuvering across all space-faring nations to prevent further collisions.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Critical military and civilian satellites cannot both be protected simultaneously. Input code!
quests.explanation: Satellite priority assessment determines which assets provide the most critical functions and must be protected first.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: International Space Debris Coordination meeting required within 24 hours. Input code!
quests.hint: Convene an emergency space debris summit.
quests.explanation: Emergency space debris summits convene within 24 hours to coordinate maneuver plans and prevent cascading Kessler syndrome.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Global pandemic at peak with healthcare systems collapsing in 40 nations. Input code!
quests.hint: Issue the pandemic peak global response code.
quests.explanation: Pandemic peak codes trigger emergency WHO resource allocation, field hospital deployment, and medical staff redeployment.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Treatment protocol requiring urgent distribution to healthcare workers worldwide. Input code!
quests.explanation: Global protocol distribution ensures all healthcare workers follow the most current and effective treatment guidelines.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: International medical oxygen supply crisis requiring emergency redistribution. Input code!
quests.explanation: International oxygen redistribution reallocates industrial gas production to medical priorities during surge demand.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Major geomagnetic storm threatening to destroy critical satellite and grid infrastructure. Input code!
quests.explanation: Geomagnetic storm protection powers down vulnerable satellites, disconnects transformers, and activates underground command centers.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Long-duration transformer damage could leave regions without power for months. Input code!
quests.hint: Protect critical transformers from geomagnetic damage.
quests.explanation: Protective disconnection of grid transformers before geomagnetic induction peaks prevents permanent high-voltage damage.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Space weather forecasting agencies coordinating global alert for the storm peak. Input code!
quests.hint: Issue a coordinated global space weather alert.
quests.explanation: Global space weather alerts provide 15 to 30 minute lead times for infrastructure operators to take protective action.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Complex multi-state nuclear power emergency requiring federal coordination. Input code!
quests.explanation: Multi-state nuclear coordination prevents conflicting evacuation orders for populations near state lines around the plant.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Conflicting state evacuation orders creating dangerous public confusion. Input code!
quests.explanation: Federal coordination authority supersedes state orders and produces a single unified evacuation zone and route plan.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: National nuclear emergency operations center assuming command of the response. Input code!
quests.hint: Activate the national nuclear emergency operations center.
quests.explanation: National nuclear EOC activation brings all nuclear agencies and military under one coordinated command for major nuclear events.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: International maritime nuclear incident in high seas requiring flag state notification. Input code!
quests.hint: Notify the flag state of the nuclear maritime incident.
quests.explanation: Flag state notification is required under maritime law and triggers the vessel registered nation to deploy response assets.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: IAEA maritime nuclear emergency team requested to assess the vessel. Input code!
quests.hint: Request the IAEA maritime emergency team.
quests.explanation: IAEA maritime teams carry portable radiation measurement equipment and provide technical advice on marine nuclear incidents.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Exclusion zone needed around the vessel in international waters. Input code!
quests.explanation: Maritime exclusion zones in international waters require coordination with coastal states and IMO notification.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Simultaneous CBRN attacks on multiple allied nations requiring joint response. Input code!
quests.explanation: Allied CBRN joint response shares intelligence, equipment, and personnel across treaty partners for coordinated defense.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Shared medical countermeasure stockpiles being accessed by multiple nations simultaneously. Input code!
quests.explanation: Allied MCM sharing agreements allow partner nations to access each other stockpiles when their own supplies are exhausted.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Coordinated public health messaging required across all affected allied nations. Input code!
quests.hint: Issue coordinated allied public health messaging.
quests.explanation: Coordinated messaging prevents conflicting national advisories that undermine public compliance and trust during CBRN events.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Strategic infrastructure protection requiring simultaneous action across all sectors. Input code!
quests.explanation: Strategic protection coordinates military, law enforcement, and infrastructure operators to harden all essential services simultaneously.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Adversary probing defenses across energy, transport, and financial sectors. Input code!
quests.explanation: Adversary probing alerts activate heightened monitoring and pre-positioning of cyber and physical defense teams.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: National resilience plan being activated across all ministries simultaneously. Input code!
quests.explanation: National resilience plans ensure essential services continue despite widespread infrastructure disruption across multiple sectors.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: National continuity of government being activated for the first time in decades. Input code!
quests.hint: Activate tier one continuity of government.
quests.explanation: Tier one COG activation relocates the head of government, cabinet, and essential agencies to hardened alternate facilities.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Classified government operations transferring to hardened underground facilities. Input code!
quests.explanation: Underground command facilities provide blast-hardened, EMP-shielded, and radiation-protected government operations continuity.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Public communication maintained through emergency broadcast system during COG activation. Input code!
quests.explanation: Emergency broadcast system activation maintains public information and government authority communication during COG transitions.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Global coordination required for a multi-hazard planetary emergency. Input code!
quests.explanation: Planetary emergency coordination assembles heads of government, military, and scientific leaders under UN emergency authority.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: UN Security Council convening emergency session for coordinated global response. Input code!
quests.hint: Convene the UN Security Council emergency session.
quests.explanation: UNSC emergency sessions authorize binding resolutions that require all nations to commit resources to the coordinated response.

quests.dispatcherQuestion: Global emergency communications network activated to maintain coordination. Input code!
quests.hint: Activate the global emergency communications network.
quests.explanation: The global emergency communications network maintains diplomatic and military coordination when normal infrastructure fails.
